why: The floor under design-system/figma/node-types.json's recorded node count. It may rise as `npm run audit:figma-registry` records more mappings, and never falls except by a hand edit that explains the deletion. Re-measure and raise it with `npm run check:figma-node-types -- --update`. Lowered from 85 to 68: Card, Divider, Collapse, Jumbotron, List group, Media object, Scrollspy, Nav pills and Navbar were retired out of Storybook and their 17 node mappings deleted. Lowered from 75 to 72: Dropdown was retired for DropdownMenu, which has no Figma mapping of its own yet, taking its 3 node mappings (button, set, set-list menu) with it. Lowered from 72 to 71 (#1629): NavTabs.Dropdown was dropped when NavTabs became Tabs on Base UI, taking its one node mapping (`_Tab Dropdown`, 4209:29375) with it.
